title: fastpath: safe-mode gating + precision toggle for KV scheduler fallback correctness
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: intermittent correctness regressions observed when the fast-path kernel runs with lower precision and the KV-cache scheduler performs aggressive evictions/continuations under continuous-batching workloads. These failures surface as rare token-level hallucinations and alignment mismatches in internal QA traces. This PR introduces a conservative "safe-mode" gating layer and an explicit precision-toggle boundary so the runtime can prefer correctness over microsecond savings when heuristics indicate risk. Goals: 1) Ensure no regressions in output correctness for workloads that exercise KV cache continuity and scheduler-driven rescheduling. 2) Maintain most fast-path performance wins for well-behaved workloads. 3) Provide observability and opt-in flags for customers and internal per-route policies. Changes in this PR: - Add safe-mode gating logic to the fast-path selection pipeline: when the scheduler detects frequent KV cache rewinds, out-of-order seq ranges, or precision-mix across layers, the runtime disables the low-precision fast-path (falls back to baseline kernels). - Introduce an explicit precision_toggle API on model-serving configs so operators can force high-precision execution per-model/per-route. - Modify KV scheduler to expose a "continuity score" metric and to stop aggressive preemptive re-merge when continuity score is below threshold. - Add an automated fallback path that conservatively invalidates KV prefixes only when safe-mode is off, reducing correctness risks from stale KV reuse. - Add targeted unit and integration tests (deterministic traces) and a perf harness to compare safe-mode on/off scenarios. - Docs: developer notes on heuristics, recommended thresholds, and how to toggle precision in Dedicated/Private deployments. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated behind runtime.config.fastpath_safe_mode (default: enabled in canary for 1 week, then broader rollout). Observability: continuity_score, fastpath_elected(bool), fastpath_precision_mode(enum), fallback_reason(tag). Related: ENG-2021 (investigate accuracy regressions), ENG-2034 (KV scheduler refactor), SUP-879 (customer report reproducer). Checklist: - [x] Safety/regression tests added - [x] Perf comparisons collected (canary results attached) - [x] Docs/flags added - [x] Observability emitted - [x] Feature-flag gated and opt-out available Notes: This description is intentionally continuous (no section breaks) to match PR export conventions.

merge_summary: Squashed commit: safe-mode gating + precision toggle for fastpath; KV scheduler continuity scoring; tests and docs.
release_notes: Added runtime.safe_mode for fast-path correctness: introduces a safe-mode gate that disables low-precision fast-paths when KV continuity is uncertain; new precision_toggle config per model/route; observability for continuity_score and fastpath reasons. No breaking changes by default; opt-in precision toggles available.
notes: Canary results: with safe-mode enabled, tail latency increased ~2.1% but reduced correctness regressions to zero in internal reproducer. With safe-mode disabled, median latency improved by ~6-9% on typical batching workloads. Default rollout will prioritize correctness for routes with continuity_score variance > 0.15.
repro_steps: Internal reproducer attached in SUP-879 and tests/integration/test_kv_continuity.py. Run: pytest tests/integration/test_kv_continuity.py --trace to reproduce scheduler rewind case.
risk_mitigation: Feature gated behind runtime.config.fastpath_safe_mode (default enabled) and exposed precision_toggle per-route. Added regression tests and canary rollout policy. Observability emits fastpath_elected and fallback_reason so SRE can rapidly detect regressions.
hotfix_followup: No immediate hotfix required. If customers observe perf regressed on high-throughput stable workloads, advise setting runtime.config.fastpath_safe_mode=false or setting precision_toggle=high for the affected route while the root cause is investigated.
notes_for_release_manager: Enable canary group 5% for 7 days, monitor continuity_score and fastpath_fallback_rate, then ramp to 50% if no regressions. Include perf report (bench/perf_reports/fastpath_canary_2026-02-15.md) in release notes.
changelog: Runtime: introduce fastpath safe-mode gating and precision toggle; KV scheduler: continuity scoring and conservative re-merge; Observability: continuity_score, fastpath_elected, fallback_reason metrics; Docs updated.
